branch_Hollandia: NO-GO / absent by current Branch authority. Historical 13-Apr sortie to support Hollandia is not auto-copied.

15Apr_immediate_pool.note: Bataan is usable but less seasoned; Palau losses have been partly replaced during Majuro replenishment. This is a planning band, not a dawn census.

pipeline.CV18_equivalent: At Pearl/training pipeline after 4-Apr arrival-equivalent; no 15-Apr TF58 combat credit.
pipeline.Cabot_CVL28: Still campaign-out; late-Apr to mid-May return band.

US_decision: Use the Hollandia-free first-half of April for replenishment, group training, integration of Bataan, photo/recon planning and FORAGER readiness rather than inventing a substitute major carrier raid without an operational payoff.
